warning: Never upgrade a scenario to PASS without traceable runtime, browser, AT or staging evidence.

scenarios.acceptance_assertion: The homepage lists recent posts in the correct order without PHP or browser errors.

scenarios.scenario: Static homepage with assigned page content
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: The assigned static page content and H1 are visible; blog posts do not replace the front page.
The assigned Blog page displays articles and pagination at its own URL.

scenarios.scenario: Published page and very long body
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: A long page displays its full text without clipping or unintended horizontal overflow.

scenarios.scenario: Single post with images, table and embeds
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: A post displays its image, alternative text, table and embed without console or HTTP errors.

scenarios.scenario: Category, tag, author and date archives
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Category, tag, author and date archives display the correct posts and H1 with HTTP 200.
Submitting the search form displays matching results and the submitted query.
A query with no matches displays an explicit, accessible empty-results message.
An empty archive preserves its context without a broken query.

scenarios.scenario: Pagination with more than one page
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Previous, next and numbered pagination links display the correct posts across multiple pages.
An unknown URL returns HTTP 404 and a recovery option rather than an empty body.

scenarios.scenario: Custom post type fallback where installed
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: On sites with custom post types, the fallback displays the correct title and content; otherwise record a justified N/A.

scenarios.scenario: Very long title and unbroken words
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Unbroken words and long titles remain readable at 320px and 200% browser zoom.
An administrator creates a Gutenberg page; saved, reloaded and frontend text match.
An editor can save and publish a post within their permissions without administrator privileges.
Header and footer edits persist after saving and reopening and appear on the frontend.
A saved navigation item survives reopening and reaches the correct destination on desktop and mobile.
An uploaded logo and its alternative text survive reopening and appear on the frontend.

scenarios.scenario: Change colors and typography then publish
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Saved color and typography changes survive reopening and match the computed frontend CSS.

scenarios.scenario: Custom widths and full-width blocks stay consistent
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Wide and full-width alignments remain consistent between editor and frontend across viewport widths.
Blocks can be added, edited and reopened without invalid-block warnings.

scenarios.scenario: Editor changes retained after theme update
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Editor customizations survive a safe update and rollback of the same theme slug.

scenarios.scenario: Theme switch back retains WP native content
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Native WordPress content remains intact after switching themes and switching back.
At 320px, no unintended horizontal scroll occurs and menus, calls to action and focus remain usable.
At 375px, responsive content and touch targets also receive manual review.
At 390px, responsive content and touch targets also receive manual review.
At 768px, layout, wide content and navigation render correctly.
At 1024px, layout, wide content and navigation render correctly.
At 1440px, layout, wide content and navigation render correctly.
At 1920px, maximum content widths and alignments render correctly.
At 200% browser zoom and increased text size, no content or focus is lost.
RTL text, navigation and alignments preserve logical order without clipping.
Galleries, large images and tables scale between 320px and 1920px without unintended overflow.
All actions are reachable with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Escape; focus is visible.

scenarios.scenario: Mobile navigation expanded and closed by keyboard
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: The menu opens and closes by keyboard and Escape, with logical focus movement.
A human screen-reader review confirms landmarks, labels, menu state and reading order.
The search input has an accessible name and a working submit action.
Zoom from 100% to 200% and reflow at 320px do not remove content or functionality.
All actual states, including hover and focus, meet the applicable WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements.
Interactive targets meet WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8, including its applicable exceptions.
Where animation is present, reduced-motion preferences are respected without losing essential functionality.
The site logo links to the homepage with an appropriate accessible name and focus behavior.

scenarios.scenario: Navigation menu items and dropdowns work
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Navigation links and dropdowns work with both keyboard and pointer input.
Typing a query and pressing Enter or submitting opens the correct search results URL.
Previous and next links preserve the search and taxonomy context.
The 404 search field leads to matching results or the empty-results state.

scenarios.scenario: Link targets and error states work
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Internal links return successful responses or expected 404s; failures are clear and provide a recovery path.

scenarios.scenario: Document title and canonical owned by WP or SEO plugin
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: One component owns title and canonical metadata; the selected SEO plugin does not create duplicate canonicals.
Robots directives, indexing intent and sitemap URLs are correct; staging is not indexed.
Test Yoast or Rank Math only when chosen for the target site; metadata and JSON-LD are not duplicated.

scenarios.scenario: Semantic heading order on rendered routes
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: H1 and H2 semantics are correct on home, page, post, archive, search, 404 and product views.
Field LCP is at most 2.5 seconds at the mobile and desktop 75th percentile, or missing field data is disclosed.
Field CLS is at most 0.1 at the 75th percentile; image dimensions and reserved space are checked.
Field INP is at most 200 milliseconds at the 75th percentile for real interactions; lab evidence is separate.
Asset and cache headers are correct; private cart and account pages are not stored in shared caches.
Cold and warm performance is measured reproducibly on the chosen hosting; no production claim is based on an empty starter.

scenarios.scenario: WP debug log and browser network
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Core flows produce no new critical WordPress/PHP errors, missing resources, or console/network failures.

scenarios.scenario: WooCommerce absent: no errors on ordinary pages
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Home, page, post, 404 and search routes work normally without WooCommerce.

scenarios.scenario: WooCommerce activates and registers own templates
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: WooCommerce provides its own templates and Cart/Checkout Blocks without theme override conflicts.
The shop, product categories and product tags display the correct products, content and links.
Product images and gallery states work; price, stock and purchase controls are correct.
Variation selection, prices, stock, invalid states and cart contents stay consistent.
In-stock, out-of-stock and backorder settings produce the correct purchase-control states.
Adding items, changing quantities, removing items and retaining the cart session are verified in the runtime.

scenarios.scenario: Empty cart and checkout page content
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Empty cart, empty checkout, validation and empty states render correctly.
A guest order completes with verified order status and stock changes; no real payment is taken.
A signed-in customer order completes with confirmation, correct status, privacy and stock handling.
Login, logout and password reset work without publishing real email or customer data in CI.
The selected tax, shipping, coupon and payment extensions work in their approved test environment.

scenarios.scenario: Dynamic checkout excluded from public caching
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Guest A never sees guest B's cart or customer data; checkout is not publicly cached.
Mobile checkout, invalid fields, focus, error text and keyboard interactions work correctly.

scenarios.scenario: Install exact release ZIP in clean WordPress
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: The exact hashed theme ZIP installs on clean WordPress with the correct slug, version and file hashes.
With debugging enabled, reloaded routes produce no theme-related PHP fatal errors or notices.

scenarios.scenario: Confirm no missing Core assets and no PHP errors
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Core flows produce no critical PHP errors, missing scripts/assets or uncaught JavaScript page errors.

scenarios.scenario: Test declared WP 6.6 minimum + current supported core
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: The declared WordPress 6.6/PHP 8.3 minimum and current WordPress on PHP 8.3 and 8.4 are verified.

scenarios.scenario: Restore backup rollback after failed activation
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: Database and uploads restore safely after a theme change or failure; URLs and content are verified.

scenarios.scenario: Owner/QA approval after staging and independent rerun
scenarios.acceptance_assertion: TH-01 through TH-16 evidence, risk records, team review, exact ZIP/hash and owner signoff are present.
